overview_description.description:
BigID develops software that helps companies have secure customer data and satisfy privacy regulations. It uses advanced machine learning and identity intelligence to help enterprises better protect their customer and employee data at a petabyte scale. The company helps organizations manage and protect their customer data, meet data privacy and protection regulations like the CCPA and GDPR, and leverage unmatched coverage for all data across all data stores.

BigID aims to give enterprises the software to safeguard and steward customer data, by bringing data science to data privacy.

BigID has offices in the US and Israel and is founded in 2016 by security industry veterans spanning the identity, data security, big data, and governance markets.

about_short_description.short_description: BigID is a data intelligence company that helps organizations discover, manage, and protect sensitive information.

product.name: BigID Data Security Platform
product.description: A unified platform for discovering, classifying, governing, and protecting sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, and development environments.

product.name: BigID AI Security & Governance
product.description: A platform for discovering AI assets, governing AI data and access, managing AI risk, and supporting compliance across models, agents, copilots, prompts, datasets, and pipelines.

product.name: BigID DSPM
product.description: A data security posture management capability that discovers, assesses, prioritizes, and remediates data and AI risks across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

product.name: BigID Data Discovery & Classification
product.description: AI-assisted discovery and classification for identifying sensitive, personal, regulated, confidential, and business-critical data across structured and unstructured sources.

product.name: BigID Privacy Suite
product.description: A privacy management platform for data mapping, consent, assessments, vendor governance, regulatory compliance, and automated data-subject rights workflows.

product.name: BigID Data & AI Catalog
product.description: A catalog and governance capability for indexing, classifying, enriching, and searching structured, unstructured, and generative-AI data.
